title: Meghshala: Education Access for Underprivileged Children
excerpt: From RTE form support to school admissions, Meghshala is helping families convert education rights into real classroom access.
coverImageAlt: Volunteers helping families with education forms and admissions
bodyMarkdown:
## Turning rights into access

The Right to Education Act guarantees schooling, but many low-income families struggle with awareness, paperwork, and admission systems. Megh Foundation's Meghshala initiative bridges that last-mile gap.

## What the team does

- Parent awareness sessions on RTE rights
- Hands-on documentation and form support
- Guidance for school selection and timelines
- Follow-up with families until admission completion

## Why this is transformative

Each completed admission is more than enrollment. It is dignity, confidence, and a long-term pathway out of intergenerational disadvantage.
